name: diag_pack_mixed_original_consumer_check_01
command:
from pathlib import Path
import json,importlib.util
from src.tools import pbs_mixed_accounting as mixed
repo=Path.cwd().resolve()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('original_final_account',repo/'scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py');module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
for suffix in ['04','05','06','07']:
 name='gpu_pack_training_single_'+suffix
 path=repo/'results'/(name+'_mixed_accounting.json');d=json.loads(path.read_text());c=d['config'];m=d['metrics']
 account=repo/c['account_reference']['file'];canonical=module._final_accounting(repo,{m['job_id']},paths=[account])[m['job_id']]
 actual=mixed.finalized_split(repo,{'name':name,'payload':c['payload_reference']['file'],'job_id':m['job_id']},canonical)
 assert actual==m
 print('ORIGINAL_FINALIZED_SPLIT_ACCEPTED '+name+' '+json.dumps({'job_id':m['job_id'],'total_charged_gpu_hours':m['total_charged_gpu_hours'],'charged_gpu_hours_by_group':m['charged_gpu_hours_by_group']}),flush=True)
